messages:
ani: Scheduling a config-only rollout tonight 02:00 UTC (02:00-04:00). No code build. Planned changes: request timeout 5500ms -> 4800ms, batching window 40ms -> 30ms, routing floor raised for lower-cost variants, tighten tenant soft-caps by 10%. Will pin model variant v3.3-alpha for canary. Need SRE + infra ack and any tenant opt-outs.
sam: I can cover SRE. Recommend excluding reserved/dedicated tenants from canary. Also add run tag for tracing.
ani: +1 on excluding dedicated. What's canary cadence?
ani: Canary plan: 0.5% for 15m, then 5% for 30m, then 25% for 20m, then full if green. Manual hold between each phase (5m) for eyeballing.
deploy-bot: Queued deploy 1790012345 (config-only) by ani. Payload summary: {"timeout_ms":4800,"batch_window_ms":30,"soft_caps":"-10%","routing_floor":"raise"}, canary_exclude=[reserved,dedicated], pin_variant=v3.3-alpha. Running preflight checks.
ops-bot: Preflight results: lint OK, schema OK, conflict check: none, infra capacity: OK.
sam: Set alerting: if p50/p95 latency delta >150ms OR error-rate increase >0.4% absolute -> auto-rollback. Also add kvcache-miss alert at +15% relative. Notify #eng-oncall and #platform.
ani: Added alerts and pinned watch channels. Also request that all traces include tag run=1790012345 and deployer=ani.
deploy-bot: Canary start scheduled at 02:00 UTC. Phase 1 -> 0.5% traffic.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 02:00 UTC (phase 1).
sam: Seeing negligible change on p50, p95 +20ms on canary hosts. Error-rate stable. kvcache miss +4%. OK to proceed after 15m.
ani: Proceed to 5% now?
sam: Proceed.
deploy-bot: Ramping to 5% at 02:20 UTC.
sam: At 5% now. p95 +35ms, errors steady. kvcache misses up +10% on a subset of pods. Marking INF-5011 to track kv miss trend post-release.
frank: Adding note: if kv miss crosses 18% on any region, we trigger TTL bump rollback-safe plan.
ani: We prefer not to change TTL in-window unless critical. Hold for manual review 5m.
deploy-bot: 5% steady for 30m. No auto-rollback triggered. Preparing 25% ramp at 02:55 UTC with 5m manual hold.
sam: Observability: tail traces show slightly more cache misses in long-tail requests only. No increase in 5xxs.
frank: Recommend continuing; create follow-up ticket INF-5012 to evaluate batching vs kvcache interaction.
ani: OK proceed to 25%.
deploy-bot: Ramping to 25% at 03:05 UTC.
sam: At 25% now. p95 +55ms overall, error-rate +0.1%. kvcache misses +13% cluster-wide but under 18% threshold. No rollback.
ani: Hold 20m and then full rollout if steady.
deploy-bot: 25% steady for 20m. No alerts fired. Scheduling full rollout at 03:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: Full rollout started at 03:30 UTC.
ops-bot: Post-rollout automated checks: service healthy, error-rate within configured delta, latency increase within alert thresholds.
sam: I'll keep on-call open for another hour to watch long-tail.
frank: INF-5011/INF-5012 filed for kv follow-up and batch tuning.
ani: Closing change window. Release notes: config-only update adjusting timeouts, batch window, routing floors, tenant soft-caps. Canary excluded reserved/dedicated. Run: 1790012345. Tickets: INF-5010 (release), INF-5011 (kvcache tracking), INF-5012 (batch-kv investigation).
sam: Thanks everyone. We'll schedule postmortem-like notes in the morning if KV trend persists.
deploy-bot: Deploy complete for 1790012345. All steps finished successfully.
